verification_method: Review recomputed the official installer and portable-installed ISCC.exe byte lengths and SHA-256 values; verified installer Authenticode publisher Pyrsys B.V.; and used the existing 6.7.1 ISSigTool to verify installer ECDSA against exact tag is-7_1_0 definition def02. Installed native DLL, e32, and e64 ECDSA material was checked separately. The x64 compiler supports an explicitly selected x86 Setup output, so both templates set SetupArchitecture=x86. CI downloads the exact URL, verifies installer length and SHA-256, requires Valid Authenticode with simple-name publisher Pyrsys B.V. before execution, waits for portable installation, then verifies ISCC.exe length and SHA-256.
trust_scope: These pins identify the exact reviewed compiler-installer and ISCC.exe bytes and require the expected publisher check before CI executes the installer. They do not independently reproduce upstream review, authenticate every installed native component, or qualify a Scribe release.
